description: Have a voice agent call someone: agentId, to (E.164), from (a number on the platform, or for Retell one of the brand's numbers forwarded to it; default the agent's own number), variables (values the agent's prompt uses, e.g. {name:'Ana'}), scheduledAt (Vapi). The platform places the call and bills it; no credits. In the US the FCC requires prior express written consent for marketing calls made with an AI voice; getting it is the caller’s responsibility. Needs Vapi, Retell AI or ElevenLabs connected (Connectors, or connect_connector with the API key), or Telnyx for its AI Assistants.

provider.description: only when more than one voice platform is connected

name: place_voice_agent_call
